steps.content: The bloodshed has ended, but that manic bloodlust has not yet dissipated. She steps forwards on shattered blades, covered in blood and looking for her next prey like Death. A fire burns up in her eyes once again.
The fire is getting out of control, burning away, and going wild with the heartbeat in the stone altar.
The inheritance hasn't fallen dormant with the annihilation of those minions; it is still throbbing. Then somewhere deep in your head, a chaotic voice rings...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: ...So powerful... I want it... I want her... Come to me...
This is the bewitchment of the inheritance, of Mania!

options: Zoya, stay away from the stone altar. Don't get yourself contaminated!

steps.content: The response she gives you is one of irrepressible anger.
At this moment, a pair of grubby hands take hold of Zoya.
